actionTitle.message: RepoShout — send this GitHub page's link to X's composer
actionTitle.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon. The page title is never sent (R15-001), so this must not promise it.

commandShareToX.message: Send the current GitHub page's link to X's composer
commandShareToX.description: Shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts. The page title is never sent (R15-001).

shareButtonLabel.description: Text on the button added to GitHub pages. Keep it short; it sits next to Fork and Star.

shareButtonTooltip.message: Send this page's link to X's composer
shareButtonTooltip.description: Tooltip on the in-page Share button. The page title is never sent (R15-001).

shareButtonAria.description: Accessible name of the in-page Share button.

noticeCredential.message: This page's address may contain sensitive authentication information, so the X composer was not opened. Nothing was sent to X.
noticeCredential.description: Shown when sharing is refused because the outgoing URL matches one of the credential patterns. Must not include the URL or any value.

noticeUnsupported.message: This page cannot be shared. Nothing was sent to X.
noticeUnsupported.description: Shown when the page is out of scope (settings, authentication, non-GitHub). Must not include the URL.

noticeOpenFailed.message: The X composer could not be opened. Nothing was sent to X.
noticeOpenFailed.description: Shown when both the popup window and the tab could not be opened. Must not include the URL or any value.

noticeOpenUnknown.message: The browser did not confirm whether the X composer window opened. If a window did open, it may not close with Escape. Nothing else was sent to X.
noticeOpenUnknown.description: Shown when chrome.windows.create resolved without a window id, so the extension cannot tell whether a window opened. Must not include the URL or any value.

noticeReloadRequired.message: The extension was updated. Reload this GitHub tab and try again. Nothing was sent to X.
noticeReloadRequired.description: Shown when the page still runs an old content script after an update (R16-003). Must not include the URL or any value.
